${modID}:BrokenSwordMound.NAME: Abandoned Equipment Yard
DESCRIPTIONS: Scrapped heavy equipment litters the Spire's shadow, each hulk as heavy as a door.
You drag a still-working rig out of the scrap. It resonates faintly with your spirit.
You gather the wreckage into neat rows, burying a piece of your past within.
OPTIONS: [Salvage] Obtain a random Tactical Equipment card.
[Bury the Wreckage] Remove a card from your deck.

${modID}:LostNotebook.NAME: Lost Notebook
DESCRIPTIONS: You find a notebook full of battle records among the Spire's ruins. Its cover is worn from repeated handling.
You read through the stranger's battle records and feel your spirit settle.
You copy several useful passages into your terminal.
You tear out a few pages for yourself and toss the rest into the fire - what can't be remembered, let it go.
OPTIONS: [Tear Up] Remove a card from your deck.

${modID}:RestlessFlames.NAME: Restless Flames
DESCRIPTIONS: An ownerless flame flickers in the Spire's corridor. It swells as you approach, as if answering your spirit.
The fire scorches your arm, but it also kindles something in your mind.
You warm yourself by the fire, and your restless thoughts slowly calm.
You leap into the flames! Amid the agony, a burning-hot object drops into your pack.
OPTIONS: [Touch the Flame] #rLose #r8 #rHP. Obtain a random instability card.

${modID}:SpireScavenger.NAME: Spire Scavenger
DESCRIPTIONS: You stop beside an adventurer's remains. His pack hangs open, revealing coins and a yellowed IOU.
You rummage through the pack and come away richer - though a sticky lump of Originium crystal has somehow found its way into your pocket.
You close the dead man's eyes and build a small cairn of stones.
